eb.ext_bank_account_id = ow.ext_bank_account_id(+) AND ow.primary_flag(+) = 'Y' -- AND NVL(ow.end_date, SYSDATE + 10) > SYSDATE ) CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS, CE_CONTACT_ASSIGNMENTS, HZ_RELATIONSHIPS, HZ_PARTIES, HZ_PARTIES PARTY_REL WHERE CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_BRANCH_ID = CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_BRANCH_ID AND CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = CE_CONTACT_ASSIGNMENTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID(+) AND
